known_issues: Playlist creation fails with 'track is not in the media library' error despite successful track upload

existing_features.title: Update the CreatePlaylistFromLibraryDialog component to refresh the media library query after track selection to ensure recently uploaded tracks are available for playlist creation.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix the 'track is not in the media library' error that occurs when creating a playlist after successfully uploading a track. Ensure uploaded tracks are properly registered in the media library before playlist creation attempts.

projectName: Fix playlist creation error for uploaded tracks
